summary: 为65岁以上独居老人设计的AI陪伴设备，提供情感陪伴、语音交流、健康提醒功能。产品形态为圆润有机形态（类似鹅卵石、水滴），中性灰白色系，小型显示屏+语音交互，多场景可移动使用。

official_sources.title: ElliQ - AI Companion for Older Adults
official_sources.notes: ElliQ is the leading AI companion robot for older adults, designed by Fuseproject/Intuition Robotics. Two-part design: emotive head with LED expression + tablet screen body. Stationary companion focused on proactive engagement, video calls, health monitoring. Key competitor reference.

official_sources.title: ElliQ Case Study - Fuseproject
official_sources.notes: Fuseproject case study for ElliQ. Design philosophy: stationary companion that empowers older adults to age in place. Emotive head design creates personality and connection. Screen body provides information and video calls. Key insight: design for dignity, not medical device aesthetic.

official_sources.title: ZCO Design AI Companion Robot
official_sources.notes: ZCO Design concept for AI companion robot for elderly. Rounded organic form, integrated screen, sensor array. Shows industrial design approach to elderly companion device with warm, approachable aesthetics. Good reference for form language and interaction design.

official_sources.title: Smart Home for Seniors - Wirecutter
official_sources.notes: Wirecutter roundup of smart home devices for aging in place. Covers voice assistants, smart displays, health monitoring. Key insight: seniors prefer simple, voice-first interfaces. Devices should feel like home decor, not medical equipment.

official_sources.title: Soove Smart Speaker Concept - Yanko Design
official_sources.notes: Soove smart speaker concept with conical organic form wrapped in fabric. Shows how warm textile materials can soften technology products. Reference for fabric-wrapped CMF and organic form language.

official_sources.title: Minimalist Smart Home Devices - Yanko Design
official_sources.notes: Roundup of smart home devices designed for minimalist living spaces. IKEA Dirigera hub and other devices show how technology can blend into warm home interiors. Reference for CMF and lifestyle integration.

official_sources.title: Shell-Shaped Smart Speaker - Yanko Design
official_sources.notes: Shell-shaped smart speaker concept with organic rounded form inspired by seashell. Shows how natural organic shapes can be applied to consumer electronics. Reference for pebble/drop-shaped form language.

do_not_duplicate: ElliQ的两段式头部+屏幕身体造型
Amazon Echo的圆柱形织物包裹造型
safe_design_directions: 圆润有机形态（鹅卵石、水滴等自然形态），无棱角
中性灰白色系，温暖不刺眼
哑光质感，温暖触感材质（织物、硅胶、陶瓷质感）
小型显示屏+语音交互，触控按键辅助
大按键、大字体、大音量设计
多场景可移动使用（床头、客厅、书房）
强调安全感和陪伴感，避免医疗感

focus.form_language: 圆润有机形态为主流方向。ElliQ采用两段式设计（头部+身体），ZCO Design采用一体式圆润造型。自然形态灵感（鹅卵石、水滴、贝壳）可应用于消费电子产品。
focus.cmf_material: 哑光质感为主流。织物包裹（Soove概念）、哑光白/灰塑料（IKEA Dirigera）、硅胶质感均为可行方向。中性灰白色系适合家庭环境。
focus.interaction_design: 语音优先+屏幕辅助。ElliQ采用LED表情头部+平板屏幕身体。大按键、大字体、简单交互为适老化核心。触控按键作为语音交互的补充。
focus.usage_scenario: 多场景可移动使用。床头柜、客厅茶几、书房桌面为主要摆放位置。设备应融入家居环境，避免医疗感。
focus.competitor_landscape: ElliQ为市场领先者（Fuseproject设计），定位高端。Amazon Echo、Google Nest为通用智能音箱，非专为老人设计。ZCO Design为概念设计参考。
focus.design_principles: 设计尊严而非医疗设备。设备应感觉像家居装饰，而非医疗器材。温暖、亲和、安全感为核心情感目标。

competitor_or_peer_references.name: ElliQ
competitor_or_peer_references.what_to_learn: 市场领先的老年AI陪伴设备。两段式设计（LED表情头部+平板屏幕身体）。设计哲学：为尊严而设计，非医疗设备。学习其情感化设计、交互方式、产品定位。

competitor_or_peer_references.name: ZCO Design AI Companion Robot
competitor_or_peer_references.what_to_learn: 概念设计参考。一体式圆润造型，集成屏幕和传感器。学习其形态语言、交互设计、适老化细节。

competitor_or_peer_references.name: Amazon Echo / Google Nest
competitor_or_peer_references.what_to_learn: 通用智能音箱参考。学习其语音交互、CMF设计（织物包裹、哑光塑料）、家居融合设计。但需注意它们非专为老人设计。

open_questions: 目标用户的具体年龄段细分（65-75岁 vs 75-85岁 vs 85+）是否影响设计决策？

设备的移动性需求程度（固定摆放 vs 频繁移动）？
预算定位（高端 vs 中端 vs 入门级）？
是否需要与子女/护理人员的手机App联动？
